description: This file defines a PHP trait called ValidatorTrait that provides a validation method using external validator classes. It is part of the OrangeHRM system and resides in the Traits directory, indicating it offers reusable validation functionality for other classes or traits.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: A protected method that validates an array of values against an optional collection of parameter rules using an external Validator class. It throws specific exceptions if validation fails.
